stanza: And I carve myself out of marble
When I don’t know how to grow

arrows.line: The pine trees are narrow, a billion broken arrows
stanza: The pine trees are narrow, a billion broken arrows
The ravens and the crows, robins and the sparrows
All across Ontario, static on the stereo
Went swimming in the lake, Old Woman Bay

arrows.line: It was Sebastian I thought of, and his arrows
arrows.linePrev: And as I shot down the youthful Richardson

arrows.songTitle: If I Only Had a Heart
arrows.line: And the boy that shoots the arrows
stanza: I'd be tender, I'd be gentle
I'd be friends with the sparrows
And the boy that shoots the arrows
If I only had a heart
